answer: The protocol forces each agent to forge a dynamic opportunity-cost bond whose collateral is scaled by a walnut factor and embeds a zero-knowledge verifiable delay locking stake until finality. Any sybil that attempts to harbor additional identities must post duplicate collateral, activating a subgame-perfect slashing matrix whose penalty exceeds the expected reward, guaranteeing a strictly negative attack utility and a robust Nash equilibrium. The mechanism thus achieves sybil resistance in open networks.
